Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents.

2. Present writ petition has been preferred for quashing the First Information Report dated 28-12-2024 registered as Case Crime No.338 of 2024, under Sections 123 and 137(2) Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, Police Station Gopiganj, District Bhadohi.
3. Learned A.G.A. on the instructions submits that during investigation Section 376-D IPC has also been added against the petitioner.

sentences.text: After substantial argument, once the Court has declined to entertain the writ petition for quashing the impugned first information report then learned counsel for the petitioner states that the petitioner does not want to press the writ petition and the same may be dismissed as not pressed with liberty to invoke the remedy as available in law.
5. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as not pressed.
Needless to say that in case the petitioner is aggrieved, he may avail the remedy as available in law.
